content: Ask/Q&A UX patterns (aiuxplayground.com, shapeof.ai, uxpatterns.dev). Follow-up chips: tappable suggested next turns rendered under an answer; purpose is to reduce blank-composer abandonment and teach productive conversation structure. Design rules: 2-4 options max (more competes with primary actions and reads as a search results page); must be derived from the system's last response or the user's prior action, never generic - Perplexity's follow-ups reference specific facts from the answer, which preserves continuity and trust. Taxonomy of useful chips: clarifying questions, depth probes, comparisons, action nudges, share/export. Streaming is a separate documented output pattern and is expected baseline. Note: entry-point prompt chips (before asking) and follow-up chips (after answering) are different patterns; follow-up chips are the higher-value one.
